_meta.title: GLIDE 2 - Core Mechanics
_meta.notes: Faza 1 ekstrakcji. Tabele losowe (desert/ruins/green space/unique/oracles) i gildie/companions/gear w osobnych plikach (faza 2 i 3).

dice_notation.2d10: roll two ten-sided dice and add their total together
dice_notation.d100: roll 2d10, one die = 10s, other = 1s (0 and 0 = 100, e.g. 0 and 1 = 11)

spend_1_for: re-roll any die or dice result
use instead of Stamina or Supply
decrease Difficulty Level of a location by 1 (min 1)
trade for rewards in a settlement

gear.note: at 0 wear, gear unusable; using gear marks 1 wear unless it has an ongoing effect

wear.on_zero: max Speed becomes 1, no Mods usable

supply.on_empty: mark 1 Wear on glider instead of spending Supply

speed.note: max can increase further via Gear/Traits/other effects

seeker_roles.goal: Complete 6 total Settlement Events with Major Successes
seeker_roles.reward_trait: Survival Training: +1 Hardy, +1 Resourceful, +1 Max Stamina

seeker_roles.starting_bonus_trait: Haggler: Advantage on Connected and Knowledgeable tests in Settlements
seeker_roles.reward_trait: Hard Bargain: Scrap sold worth +d5 additional Credits (max 3x/settlement visit), Supplies discounted 1cr (max 3x/visit), +1 Knowledgeable or Resourceful

seeker_roles.starting_bonus_trait: Experienced Delver: re-roll Challenge die (1x per Explore)
seeker_roles.reward_trait: Survival Knowledge: Camp action always restores +1 Supply, may re-roll Camp Event (1x per Camp), +1 Hardy/Resourceful/Focused

seeker_roles.starting_bonus_trait: Work-for-Hire: always find +1 Scrap from Major successes when Exploring
seeker_roles.reward_trait: Well-Travelled: +1 to two different Stats of choice; if a Bond Point reward would be less than +3, add +1 to it (0 and negatives don't count)

seeker_roles.starting_bonus_trait: Sightseer: start with Wayfinder Binoculars Gear (p. 81) and max Intel
seeker_roles.goal: Reveal a total of 40 hexes (all location types count)
seeker_roles.reward_trait: Pathfinder: move through Non-traversable locations, minimum 2 Speed, +1 Resourceful or Focused

seeker_roles.starting_bonus_trait: Off-World Contacts: all Relics sold worth +25cr
seeker_roles.reward_trait: The Highest Bidders: +1 Resourceful, +1 Knowledgeable, Relics sold worth an additional +50 Credits

challenge_resolution.roll: 2 separate d10: Player Die (+ chosen/listed stat + bonuses, max +5) and Challenge Die (+ Difficulty Level of location)

outcomes.condition: Player Die total >= 2x Challenge Die total
Player Die total >= Challenge Die total
Player Die total < Challenge Die total

challenge_resolution.gear_use: may use matching equipped Gear on a Challenge Roll; mark 1 Wear per item used; unusable at 0 Wear
challenge_resolution.companion_aid: spend 1 companion Stamina for +1 to the roll if companion has the Key Stat listed; companion needs >=1 Stamina

location_level_table_d10.note: brak wpisu w oryginale - możliwa luka w druku, zweryfikować przy okazji

location_level_special_cases.impassible_terrain: no Difficulty Level (treat as 0), cannot be Explored

exhaustion_table_d10.name: Barely Holding On
exhaustion_table_d10.effect: mark 1 Wear on glider and any gear; move to closest revealed hex outside closest settlement

exhaustion_table_d10.name: The Desert Takes Its Due
exhaustion_table_d10.effect: move to a random hex (roll on map), then to nearest revealed hex; lose 1 Supply

exhaustion_table_d10.name: Scavenged While Down
exhaustion_table_d10.effect: lose half Credits (rounded up) and 3 Scrap

exhaustion_table_d10.name: Wanting Rescue
exhaustion_table_d10.effect: lose 1 Relic or 3 Scrap; if unable to pay, -3 Bond Points with any Guild

exhaustion_table_d10.name: Harmful Recovery
exhaustion_table_d10.effect: mark d5 Wear on gear and/or glider (any combination)

exhaustion_table_d10.name: Badly Bandaged
exhaustion_table_d10.effect: wake at nearest settlement; -1 Supply, -d100 Credits

exhaustion_table_d10.name: Lost Time
exhaustion_table_d10.effect: wake at nearest settlement; -2 Supply, -1 Intel, -1 Fame

exhaustion_table_d10.name: Brush with Death
exhaustion_table_d10.effect: roll d10 sub-table: 1-4 lose 2 gear and 3 Supply / 5-8 -2 Bond Points x3 (any combination) and -2 Intel / 9-10 mark 1 Wear on all gear and glider, lose all Relics and Scrap

camping_events_table_d100.effect: A soft wind keeps the night cool and restful (+1 Stamina)
A strange pattern is seen in the stars above (+1 Momentum)
A caravan passes by, sharing rumours (+1 Supply and Momentum)
An acquaintance reaches out, checking in on you (+1 Momentum)
A clear night sky guides your thoughts (+1 Momentum)
A fellow Seeker stops to share food and drink (+1 Momentum and Stamina)
A sudden sand squall buries your campsite (-1 Supply and Stamina)
A warm night makes rest easy (+1 Stamina)
A strange dream wakes you suddenly (-1 Stamina)
A guiding dream reveals a safe path forward (+3 Momentum)
A stash of supplies is found near your campsite (+1 Supply)
A relic storm flickers to life across the horizon (-1 Momentum)
A strange marking is left in the sand (-1 Momentum)
A gift is left by the entrance to your tent (+1 Relic)
A strange hum distracts your sleep for the night (-1 Stamina)
A sandstorm makes rest impossible (-1 Momentum and Stamina)
A hidden oasis beneath your campsite is found (+1 Stamina)
A small patch of greenery grows beneath your tent (+1 Momentum)
A collection of your supplies spoil (-1 Supply)
A sandquake shakes your campsite (-1 Momentum)
A sudden shift in temperature chills you (-1 Stamina)
A meal that turns out better than you expected (+1 Stamina)
A restful night with no interruptions (+1 Stamina)
Roll twice (max once per Camp action)

end_game.retire_condition: 10+ Fame, spend an action while in any Settlement
end_game.legacy_score_formula: Current Fame + number of Level 4 Guild Bonds + number of Level 4 Companion Bonds

path_a_living_legend.name: The Faction Patron
path_a_living_legend.effect: next character starts with Bond Level 3 automatically with one chosen Guild

path_a_living_legend.name: The Masterwork Inheritance
path_a_living_legend.effect: next character starts with one Level 2 Glider Upgrade and any one Advanced Gear

path_a_living_legend.name: The Veteran's Teachings
path_a_living_legend.effect: next character permanently increases two chosen Stats by +1 during character creation

path_a_living_legend.name: Hidden Caches
path_a_living_legend.effect: next character starts with max Supply, Scrap, Intel, Relics, and +100 Credits

path_b_trade_in.new_identity: choose a brand-new Seeker Background, keeping all benefits thus far
path_b_trade_in.severed_bonds: all Guild and Companion Bond Levels reset to Level 0; remove all Bond Rewards gained

choose_2_rewards.name: Ghost Thrusters
choose_2_rewards.effect: permanent +1 Speed, does not occupy a mod slot

end_game.map_blueprint: regardless of path: roll d100 on Unique Location table (p. 132/131), place as new Unique Location on empty hex (or replace existing Desert location); name after retired Seeker; treat as Level 0
